briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: NVIDIA, 17 November 2026

**Context:** The meeting falls on the same day NVIDIA reports Q3 results and holds its first earnings call since its CEO change. Results are due around 4:20 p.m. ET, with the call at 5 p.m. ET (https://mashable.com/tech/jensen-huang-affairs-nvidia-resignation-timeline).

## Changes in the last 30 days

**Leadership (the main change)**
- NVIDIA announced that Jensen Huang has left all his positions with immediate effect, including chairman, CEO and director (https://meteoraweb.com/en/news/nvidia-jensen-huang-steps-down-as-ceo).
- Huang led the company for 33 years. Longtime CFO Colette Kress was named interim CEO on Thursday, 12 Nov (https://mashable.com/tech/jensen-huang-affairs-nvidia-resignation-timeline).
- Kress has been CFO since September 2013 and stays CFO until a successor is chosen. The board has started a search and will consider internal and external candidates (https://meteoraweb.com/en/news/nvidia-jensen-huang-steps-down-as-ceo).
- On 8 Nov, the board said it had confidence in Huang and his leadership team and would provide updates as appropriate (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors). This was before the change was announced.
- The Wall Street Journal reported on 11 Nov that the board was preparing to oust Huang over two extramarital affairs, one reportedly with a suspected Chinese spy. The report cites people familiar with the matter (https://www.wsj.com/business/nvidia-is-preparing-to-oust-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-30f421ad).
- Wired reported that NVIDIA hired a crisis PR firm at least a year before Huang acknowledged the affair. This was reported via a secondary aggregator (https://mezha.net/eng/news/mezha-cbe54f11b05c0e59be5a05db_wired-_nvidia_hired).
- The independent board members issued a statement on 10 Nov. The search results show only the headline, not its content (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition).

**Launches and partnerships**
- On 8 Nov, NVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom announced a collaboration on sovereign AI infrastructure using NVIDIA NVLink Fusion (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition).
- An AWS and NVIDIA announcement describes AWS deploying 2 million additional Blackwell Ultra, Rubin and Rubin Ultra GPUs across 2027 and 2028 (https://shattered.io/gpu-vs-tpu-vs-npu-ai-chip-camps-compared-2026). This is a secondary source summarizing the announcement.
- Vera Rubin NVL72 debuted in MLPerf Inference v6.1 results in September 2026. Rubin reportedly moved into production shipments in the second half of 2026 (https://shattered.io/gpu-vs-tpu-vs-npu-ai-chip-camps-compared-2026).

**Deals and hires**
- I found no acquisitions announced in the last 30 days. The most recent in the results is Hugging Face (1 Aug 2026, USD 12.90B). Others are older: Kumo.AI (1 Jun 2026), Illumex (1 Feb 2026) and Groq (1 Dec 2025, USD 20.00B) (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/TXRhn2TKUD7t). The dates in this list are not announcement dates, so treat them with care.
- I found no executive hires in the results. The PR firm hire above is the only related item.

## Gaps
- The search results contain headlines and summaries, not full statements. Check the primary releases before relying on wording.
- Most leadership facts come from press reports. The WSJ and Wired items are unconfirmed by NVIDIA.

## Open questions
1. What is the board's timeline for naming a permanent CEO, and how will Kress's dual role as interim CEO and CFO affect the Q3 results and call?
2. Is the Rubin ramp and the AWS 2027–2028 GPU deployment still on schedule under the new leadership?
3. What governance and disclosure steps has the board taken regarding the reported circumstances, and do any of these affect partner or customer commitments?
